name: Atelier Helix v1 evolve

remote_ci.note: Red at 1e1a265: six 3.11-only errors from loom.text_meta calling the 3.12 builtin int.is_integer(). Fixed in R20; the local 3.12 gate could not see it.

remaining_product_holes: No browser-raster PNG of the live board — sheet.png is a contact sheet painted from node boxes, and an SVG artifact asked for as PNG comes back a labeled card, not the artwork
Paid StyleLock is a '[StyleLock brand=… palette=…]' prompt prefix, not pixel ΔE enforcement — nothing measures what the provider returned
UI weave still uses stream=0; SSE is live on the server but app.js has no EventSource, so the dock never subscribes
Undo deletes the node and leaves the artifact row and its file on disk; no redo
Text edit is still window.prompt, not a caret on the card
Reference upload and spot-edit are text-only: the uploaded pixels never leave the machine, the prompt only names the parent's filename
No pick-winner — 4-up variants share no set identity (parent_id null, node meta {}), and there is no promote or cull route, only undo in reverse
Eval factsheet fixture fails the demo lane: its palette hexes sit past the 180-char caption echo and the fixture carries no kit
The eval palette check can pass on that caption echo alone — brand_apply still scores ok with its brand kit deleted
Brand kits drop fonts: update_brand_kit stores name/palette/voice only, so Archivo/Inter ride the brief echo
Non-Latin briefs (CJK, Cyrillic) still slug to the hex id on download
openai_compat has no allowed-host suffix — any base_url is accepted, stored and shown as configured
No OPENAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY in this environment — the paid loop is unproven end to end
